POET.headline: Speculative AI-optics rebound
POET.summary: POET's May 1-May 8 breakaway looks like a rebound rally after the prior Marvell-order cancellation selloff. Reporting during the split noted that shares were roaring higher in May despite no major new public business update, helped by broader AI-stock momentum, order-outlook speculation, and possible meme-stock trading.
POET.sourceLabel: Motley Fool: Why Poet Stock Gained 19.9% Last Month and Is Skyrocketing in May

ANET.headline: Beat-and-raise was not enough
ANET.summary: ANET's May 1-May 8 fade came after Arista beat Q1 sales and earnings estimates but sold off anyway. Investors focused on guidance that did not clear high expectations and management's supply-constraint comments, which raised concerns about near-term performance.
ANET.sourceLabel: Motley Fool: Why Arista Networks Stock Plummeted Today
